title: 3 Sum
description:
Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that i != j, i != k, and j != k, and nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0.

Notice that the solution set must not contain duplicate triplets. Triplets must be sorted internally and output triplets must be lexicographically sorted. Each triplet printed on a new line. If no triplets exist, print 'No Triplets'.

Input format:
First line: n (size of array)
Second line: a1 a2 a3 ... an

Example:
6
-1 0 1 2 -1 -4
